subject: Overflow help for AI app launch sprints
body:
Hi ShipMyAI team,

I saw your 72h production launch offer for AI-built apps. If you ever need overflow help on scoped pieces, I can take small production-cleanup tasks under your review: repo triage notes, auth/env checks, deploy debugging, Stripe webhook checks, Supabase/Firebase rule review, and before/after QA notes.

I put the focused scope here: https://tatelyman.github.io/tate-web-services/ai-app-rescue.html

I am not pitching to take over client strategy. The useful angle is lower-risk extra capacity for repetitive triage and focused fixes when a sprint has too many small blockers.

If helpful, send one sanitized sample task or stuck flow and I will reply with how I would scope it.

Tate Lyman
https://tatelyman.github.io/tate-web-services/
lymantate2@gmail.com
